description: Defines classes and structures for QUIC crypto client configuration, including resumption state, session cache interface, and client crypto configuration with methods for handling handshake messages, server configs, and caching.

classes.name: QuicResumptionState
classes.description: Stores state needed for QUIC connection resumption, including TLS session, transport parameters, application state, and token.

classes.name: SessionCache
classes.description: Interface for managing storage and retrieval of QuicResumptionState objects.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig
classes.description: Holds crypto configuration for QUIC client, including cached server states, handshake message handling, and server config management.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::CachedState
classes.description: Contains information needed for 0-RTT handshake with a server, including server config, proof, and validity status.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::ServerIdFilter
classes.description: Abstract class for filtering server IDs for partial config deletion.

methods.name: LookupOrCreate
methods.description: Returns cached state for a server ID, creating it if not present.

methods.name: ClearCachedStates
methods.description: Removes cached states matching a filter.

methods.name: FillInchoateClientHello
methods.description: Creates a client hello message to elicit server info.

methods.name: FillClientHello
methods.description: Creates a client hello message based on current config.

methods.name: ProcessRejection
methods.description: Processes server rejection message and updates cache.

methods.name: ProcessServerHello
methods.description: Processes server hello message and updates cache.

methods.name: ProcessServerConfigUpdate
methods.description: Processes server config update message.

methods.name: InitializeFrom
methods.description: Initializes cached state from another config.

methods.name: AddCanonicalSuffix
methods.description: Adds a domain suffix for shared server configs.

methods.name: set_user_agent_id
methods.description: Sets user agent ID for handshake messages.

methods.name: user_agent_id
methods.description: Gets the user agent ID.

methods.name: set_tls_signature_algorithms
methods.description: Sets TLS signature algorithms.

methods.name: tls_signature_algorithms
methods.description: Gets TLS signature algorithms.

methods.name: set_alpn
methods.description: Sets ALPN for handshake.

methods.name: set_pre_shared_key
methods.description: Sets pre-shared key for handshake.

methods.name: pre_shared_key
methods.description: Gets pre-shared key.

methods.name: pad_inchoate_hello
methods.description: Checks if inchoate hello is padded.

methods.name: set_pad_inchoate_hello
methods.description: Sets padding for inchoate hello.

methods.name: pad_full_hello
methods.description: Checks if full hello is padded.

methods.name: set_pad_full_hello
methods.description: Sets padding for full hello.
